b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Options

| Option | Help text |
|--------|-----------|
| `URL` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Description

`tinydl` downloads a resource from the given URL and writes it to a file or stdout. It retries failed requests up to 3 times with exponential backoff (20 s timeout per attempt). Progress is reported to stderr unless `--quiet` is used.
'
